symptoms: Water-soaked dark green lesions near nut calyx; affected nuts rot, lose luster and shed in enormous quantities forming a green/brown carpet on ground; white mycelial mass coats shed nuts.
management: Consult local agricultural university / KVK package of practices for registered treatment.
prevention: Practice crop rotation, field hygiene, and use certified seeds.

management: Install pheromone traps and apply bio-control agents.

correction: Soil application of Solubor @ 20g/palm or foliar spray with Boron 20% (Disodium Octaborate Tetrahydrate) @ 2g/L.

healthy_signs: Large, deep green fronds/leaves arranged symmetrically in crown/canopy
Robust trunk/stem free from bleeding patches or fungal conks
Heavy bunches/berries with uniform maturity and no premature shedding
Active feeder roots in organic mulch basin
management: Clean decaying tissues from infected crowns/trunks and apply protective healing paste
Drench palm basins with Trichoderma viride culture mixed with neem cake
Improve basin drainage to lower water table during monsoon peaks
prevention: Clean palm crowns/canopies before South-West and North-East monsoon rains
Apply Bordeaux mixture (1%) spray to bunches and crowns prophylactically
Grow cover crops (e.g. Mucuna bracteata, Calopogonium) in basins for moisture conservation
Avoid mechanical injuries to stems and root zones during weeding
